description: Retrieve the current status of a task previously created on Taskin with submit_human_task. Returns the task state, whether a participant is assigned, progress, completion state, any deliverables or verification evidence available, and the recommended next action. Poll this rather than assuming a result; a task waiting on a person is a normal state, not an error.

taskin_agent_id.description: Taskin-issued agent identifier from an earlier response.

name: get_task_status
title: Check a Taskin task
